text.en: 1. These Regulations are the Coroners (Conduct of Proceedings) Regulations 2011.

2. In these Regulations, “Assistant Public Prosecutor” or “Deputy Public Prosecutor” means a person appointed by the Public Prosecutor to act as an Assistant Public Prosecutor or a Deputy Public Prosecutor (as the case may be) under the Criminal Procedure Code 2010.

heading.en: Officers who may assist in conduct of proceedings
